sourceScope: new generic non-Java original-native decoder/privacy port, stdin CLI, tests and owned documentation

exports: decodeNativePayload(rawBuffer,encoding) (strict structural decode only, NOT privacy verification)
port.cliArguments: NONE; all fixture publisher keys, exact markers and original raw payloads are passed on stdin only
port.input: {publisherKeys:[1..16 distinct exact UUIDv4 strings],forbiddenValues:[0..64 exact strings],payloads:[1..16 {rawBase64:canonicalBase64,encoding:identity|gzip}]}
stdoutFields: verified (input check only, NOT producer or source authority)
nativeEnvelopes original policy-scanned context/data with publisher/machine/IP/user tags omitted only after original scan
port.failure: throws static NATIVE_* only; CLI exit 1, empty stdout, one redacted code on stderr; no raw values, markers, keys or causes printed
port.sessionFailure: poisons session and clears stored projection; subsequent ingestion/snapshot fails with the original redacted code
port.wholeRunPersistenceRule: buffer receipts/projections until all required inputs pass; consumer must bound bytes while receiving and retain original-byte/PID/source/count binding

policy: strict recursive JSON parser rejects duplicate decoded names including escaped equivalents in JSON, arrays, nested objects and NDJSON before projection
fatal original UTF-8 decoding, malformed/partial/nonfinite/prototype and depth/node/key/scalar bounds before shared regex
known fixture publisher membership required at envelope top-level iKey only; missing/foreign/nested placement or copied publisher values/keys elsewhere rejected
existing values.mjs forbiddenField/forbiddenString/PSEUDONYM/UUID4 policies reused, not duplicated credential regex
original credential/personal/SQL/Redis fields/values, unsafe user identifiers and exact caller markers checked before any tag removal
no caller waiver, truncation, masking, native ID/kind/name/role/URL backfill or new provider

validation.actualCliCpuChecks: stdin positive PID/source/raw-hash/count binding, duplicate wrapper, adversarial 64-KiB scalar and exact-marker negatives; no network/provider/fixture files
exactBoundaries: one and sixteen known publishers, 64 caller markers
4096-byte ASCII/Unicode scalars and 128-byte Unicode keys; above-limit cases fail
depth 32 and 8192 fields/values; above-limit cases fail
1048576 raw and gzip-decoded bytes with multi-scalar positive; one-byte-over negative
sixteen payloads / 16777216 raw and decoded bytes; additional payload fails
512 envelopes per payload / 8192 total; additional envelope fails
33554432-byte strict CLI request parser; one-byte-over negative

scopeLimits: no peer API, async or sampler consumer edited; they must adopt the new port under their own grant and freeze current import hashes
old identity collector00e remains unchanged and is not retroactively made strict by this new source
no original raw-payload disclosure or matched finding persisted
input privacy/known fixture publisher check does not attest source, enrollment, all-table privacy, native fidelity or exporter completeness
original R2/R5 source/CPU reviews required; parent owns future actual current-source native retakes
